props.headline: Winter planning, minus the spreadsheets
props.body: Tidewell turns scattered planning docs into one schedule everyone on the team reads the same way — no more Friday afternoon status hunts.

image.alt: A Tidewell planning board showing three workstreams moving from backlog to done

props.heading: What a winter rollout gets you

items.title: One read of the schedule
items.body: Every workstream rolls up into a single timeline, so a stakeholder gets the same answer whether they ask you or open the app.

items.title: Changes never surprise you
items.body: Tidewell flags a downstream date the moment an upstream task slips, before it becomes a standup surprise.

items.title: Set up in an afternoon
items.body: Import from a spreadsheet or a ticket tracker and get a working schedule the same day, not after a quarter of onboarding.

items.title: Built for how teams actually work
items.body: Nested workstreams, dependencies, and owners map to how the work is really structured, not a flat list pretending it is.

props.quote: We stopped reconciling three versions of the plan every Monday. Now there’s just the one, and everyone trusts it.
props.name: Priya Shah
